description: Use this when you want the ranked list of top traders for a timeframe; paid with x402 ($0.25 USDC on Base for up to 100 rows, plus $0.01 per 4 more rows, maximum 500; call without payment to see the exact price). To look up one trader use trader_search_trader or trader_last_trade.

limit.description: Number of rows to return, 1 to 500. Defaults to 100; the price rises above 100 rows.
limit.title: Limit

payment.description: Base64-encoded x402 payment signature. Leave empty on the first call to receive the price and payment requirements, then call again with the signed payment.
payment.title: Payment

timeframe.description: Leaderboard period: daily, weekly, monthly, all_time, 7d or 30d (7d is weekly, 30d is monthly). Defaults to all_time.
timeframe.title: Timeframe

name: trader_get_leaderboard
